figures.finding: The Cocos (Keeling) Islands is part of Australia in the geographical sense of the Income Tax Assessment Act 1997, so Australian income tax, its withholding and its rules on non-residents apply there as in Australia.
figures.applies: Income tax law for the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands

sources.said: 960 ‑ 505 Meaning of Australia Territories (1) Australia , when used in a geographical sense, includes each of the following: (a) Norfolk Island; (b) the Coral Sea Islands Territory; (c) the Territory of Ashmore and Cartier Islands; (d) the Territory of Christmas Island; (e) the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands; (f) the Territory of Heard Island and the McDonald Islands.

figures.finding: The Cocos (Keeling) Islands lies in Zone A, so a resident living there more than half the year gets a zone rebate of $338 plus 50% of the relevant rebate amount ($1,173 plus 50% if the place counts as the special area, which is measured as more than 250 km by surface route from an urban centre of at least 2,500 people as at 1981).

value.residence: usual place of residence in the zone for more than half the year

figures.applies: Residents of Cocos (Keeling) Islands (ITAA 1936 s 79A, Schedule 2)

figures.finding: GST does not apply in The Cocos (Keeling) Islands: the indirect tax zone where GST is levied is Australia excluding the external Territories.

value.reason: outside the indirect tax zone (external Territory)
